text: DSH 产物预览插件（DSH Web / Desktop 插件）：按对话节点浏览工具结果和助手文本中报告的本地文件。它注册对话产物页，并提供图片、视频、SVGA 与普通文件的分栏查看；可按时间线选择节点、查看文件路径和来源，并在允许目录内预览媒体。还提供右侧文件预览接入和同源媒体读取接口。适合需要回看会话生成图片、视频或其他文件的 DSH 用户。使用前需在宿主配置 allowedRoots 指定可访问目录，默认不开放目录。

DSH Product Preview adds an artifact tab to DSH Web and Desktop. It groups local paths reported in conversation results by node, then provides a timeline, file browser, and previews for images, videos, and SVGA. Configure allowedRoots on the host to preview local files.
想按 DSH 对话节点查看工具生成的文件。
能不能在聊天旁边预览会话产出的图片和视频？
我想把每轮对话报告的本地文件整理成时间线。
让 DSH 展示生成文件的目录、文件名和来源工具。
想在一个分栏页面里切换会话节点并查看对应产物。
如何在 DSH 中预览本机目录里的 SVGA 动画？
I want to browse files produced during a DSH conversation by the turn that reported them.
Can I preview local images and videos from a conversation in a Finder-style panel?
按对话节点归档产物：插件从成功的工具结果和助手文本提取本地路径，并把首次报告的文件归到对应节点。用户可沿时间线选中节点，再查看该节点的文件。
分栏浏览会话文件：产物页把节点时间线、文件列表和详情预览并排展示，保留真实目录与文件名，并显示路径及来源工具信息。
预览本地媒体：选择文件后按图片、视频、SVGA 或普通文件类型显示内容；普通文件保留文件详情和宿主操作入口。
在允许目录中读取媒体：宿主注册路径校验、解析和媒体流接口；解析结果使用短时媒体地址，浏览器可请求视频字节范围。
DSH 产物预览插件默认 allowedRoots 为空；需由宿主配置允许的本地目录，文件列表与媒体解析只针对配置目录内文件。

dsh-product-preview README · DSH 产物预览插件：[`English`](./README.en.md)

`dsh-product-preview` 为 DSH 对话增加类似访达分栏视图，用于浏览本地文件产物。ZIP、JSON、PDF、表格和其他无法内嵌预览的文件仍显示文件详情，并提供打开和文件夹定位入口。

VAP 透明预览使用独立的 `video-animation-player`，不依赖公司组件库。支持带内嵌 `vapc` 的 MP4，以及包含单个 MP4 和可选 `vapc.json` 的 ZIP；保留原始帧率、静音循环播放。普通 MP4 回退到视频播放器，普通 ZIP 保留文件详情。ZIP 只在内存读取，输入和展开选定文件上限 64 MiB、配置上限 1 MiB、条目上限 128；不支持需要动态资源绑定的 VAPX。切换文件时取消读取并释放播放器和 Blob URL。播放器代码随插件浏览器包分发，按选择初始化，不在线下载额外脚本；错误时仍可打开原文件。

dsh-product-preview README · DSH 产物预览插件：在提供 `documentPreviews` 的 RC 宿主上，插件同时为右侧文件预览注册普通视频、SVGA 和 VAP（MP4 / ZIP），与产物页共用播放器。右侧仅从 live 文件资源的宿主绝对路径发起解析，仍由原有媒体服务验证 `allowedRoots`，不会开放其他目录；它面向宿主本地文件，不把远端执行环境中的同名路径视为本地授权。普通视频使用带进度控制的原生播放器和 HTTP Range，不自动播放；SVGA 与 VAP 沿用动画播放方式，输入上限 64 MiB。普通 ZIP 显示文件提示，不作为 VAP 播放。切换文件、重载或关闭页签会取消旧请求并释放播放器；解码失败保留宿主原文件操作。未提供文件预览扩展的旧宿主仍保留产物页，不强制安装新的预览模块。

紧凑三栏保留节点、真实目录与文件名，为媒体预览留出主要空间。文件大小与格式直接展示，完整路径和来源工具可在“文件详情”中展开。在产物页发送消息并获接收后，自动回到对话；发送失败则保留当前页面。待处理消息从宿主的 `useInput` 队列读取，不依赖旧版 `SessionSnapshot.queue`。

dsh-product-preview README · DSH 产物预览插件：左侧使用只读 React Flow 展示会话节点，虚线仅表示会话顺序，不推断素材依赖。点击节点沿用中间文件列表与右侧图片、视频和 SVGA 预览；支持缩放和平移，不提供拖拽修改、连线或删除。图内手势不切换会话页签。图组件按需挂载，依赖及样式编入浏览器能力包，无需公网运行时加载。

节点下方以小字显示首次报告产物的会话事件时间，使用本机时区，悬停查看完整日期；没有时间记录时不显示。节点序号使用浅色文字，选中时仍与标题区分。

在桌面端，双指左右横扫内容区可在“对话”“产物”“轨迹”间切换；侧边反馈会随手势距离拉出，到首尾页则不会出现。

插件会读取成功的工具结果和助手文本，发现其中的文件绝对路径，并将每个文件归入最先报告该路径的对话节点。无扩展名文件可通过 JSON 路径值、反引号路径或 Markdown 链接报告。界面保留原始目录与文件名，仅展示位于 `allowedRoots` 下且仍存在的普通文件，不扫描磁盘目录。非媒体文件以附件形式提供，预览大小限制不影响文件收录。

dsh-product-preview README · DSH 产物预览插件：此 bundle 不依赖特定产品或 Bot。Desktop 宿主可选地通过 `/api/product-preview/actions` 提供原生操作，例如打开、在访达中显示和右键菜单。

路径识别支持 POSIX 绝对路径、Windows 各盘符路径（正斜杠或反斜杠）和 UNC 共享路径（`\\server\share\image.png`），保留中文与空格。同一段回复中，反引号或 Markdown 链接明确给出以斜杠结尾的绝对目录后，紧随的 Markdown 列表可用反引号或链接报告相对文件名；目录只用于该列表，不跨回复或 JSON 字段推断。没有明确目录的相对路径、包含 `..` 的相对路径、网络 URL 和 Windows 设备路径不作为本地媒体产物。识别路径不授予访问权限；共享路径同样需要位于宿主配置的 `allowedRoots` 下。

dsh-product-preview README · 安装与兼容性：产物页 peer 声明允许 DSH Web / Desktop 的 `0.1.2-alpha.3`、`0.2.0-rc.1` 与 `0.2.0-rc.2`；右侧媒体预览使用可选的 RC 文件预览接口类型。安装到新宿主后仍须验收预览与原生操作。使用 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。

从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/choco9527/dsh-product-preview/releases) 获取预构建包，再安装到目标 Profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/choco9527/dsh-product-preview/releases/latest/download/dsh-product-preview.tgz
```
dsh-product-preview README · 安装与兼容性：Desktop 用户请将 `web` 替换为实际 Profile 名称。插件复用宿主的 DSH 和 React 依赖，不包含 Desktop 或 Bot。安装后需要配置允许读取的目录；默认列表为空，不会开放整个磁盘。

dsh-product-preview README · 配置：```yaml
- id: product-preview
  name: dsh-product-preview
  config:
    allowedRoots:

支持 PNG、JPEG、WebP、GIF、MP4、MOV、WebM、M4V 与 SVGA。本包内置 `svga.lite`，因此安装后预览 SVGA 不需要再从网络下载播放器。

SVGA 播放器直接编入浏览器产物，构建时检查不可残留外部包名加载。解析使用内置的主线程模式，无需额外 Worker 文件；加载和解析失败会分别显示对应状态。

dsh-product-preview README · 桌面 AI 读取动画：构建额外生成独立的 `lib/media-reader.js`，供 Argo 原生宿主在隔离的后台 Electron 窗口中抽帧；它不挂载预览页、不占用用户浏览器，也不提供独立 HTTP/MCP 服务。复用已有 `svga.lite`、`video-animation-player`、`fflate` 和 Electron 解码能力，不新增运行依赖或 FFmpeg。普通视频取解码帧，VAP 取 RGB/alpha 合成后的画面，SVGA v2 将选定精灵帧作为单帧动画渲染，避免隐藏窗口的播放时钟问题。

默认返回三个均匀时间点，可指定 1–6 帧或时间点（秒）。PNG 保留透明度、最长边不超过 2000px；输入与 SVGA 解压上限 64 MiB，VAP ZIP 沿用现有上限。时间点必须小于时长，损坏文件、解码不支持、旧版 SVGA ZIP、动态 VAPX 会明确失败。SVGA 仅还原文件自带内容，不推断头像、文字等外部动态替换；抽帧不等同于连续播放或音频转写。原始文件不修改。宿主负责超时、取消、沙箱、路径检查及将图片存成可在会话中重放的附件。

开发依赖从公开 npm registry 安装，无需同级 Desktop 仓库。DSH 与 React 声明为宿主 peer 依赖，SVGA 播放器作为开发依赖编入浏览器产物；安装预构建包无需在用户电脑运行构建脚本。

开发依赖补齐插件使用的宿主类型。`skipLibCheck` 仅跳过第三方声明文件自身的检查：DSH alpha 声明还引用宿主生成的 RPC 类型，无法在独立插件中完整验证；插件源码仍按 `strict` 检查。

text: dsh-product-preview README · DSH Product Preview Plugin：The SVGA player is compiled into the browser bundle, with a build check against unresolved package imports. Parsing runs without an external Worker file. Loading and parse failures have separate status messages.

dsh-product-preview README · DSH Product Preview Plugin：Compact Finder-style columns give media previews more room while preserving original file and directory names. Format and size remain visible; expand file details for the full path and source. Messages accepted from the artifact view return to Chat, including queued messages; failed sends keep the current view. Pending messages come from the host's `useInput` queue, not the legacy `SessionSnapshot.queue` field.

dsh-product-preview README · DSH Product Preview Plugin：The left column uses a read-only React Flow graph. Dashed edges indicate conversation order, not inferred asset dependencies. Selecting a node retains the file column and existing image, video, and SVGA previews. Pan and zoom are available; editing, connecting, and deletion are disabled. Graph gestures do not switch conversation tabs. The graph mounts on demand, with its runtime and CSS embedded in the browser bundle rather than downloaded at runtime.

dsh-product-preview README · DSH Product Preview Plugin：Each node shows the time of the conversation event that first reported its artifacts in small text, using the local time zone, with the full date on hover. Missing timestamps are omitted. Sequence numbers use subdued text even when selected, distinct from the node title.

[`中文`](./README.md)

dsh-product-preview README · DSH Product Preview Plugin：`dsh-product-preview` adds a Finder-style conversation view for local file artifacts. ZIP, JSON, PDF, spreadsheets, and other files without inline renderers retain file details, Open, and Show in folder actions.

dsh-product-preview README · DSH Product Preview Plugin：Transparent VAP playback uses `video-animation-player` independently of company component libraries. It accepts MP4 files with embedded `vapc` metadata and ZIP files containing one MP4 and optional `vapc.json`, preserving frame rate with muted looping playback. Ordinary MP4 and ZIP files retain their video and file views. ZIP decoding stays in memory: input and selected expanded files are limited to 64 MiB, configuration to 1 MiB, and entry count to 128. Dynamic VAPX resource bindings are unsupported. File switches cancel reads and release the player and Blob URL. Player code ships in the browser bundle and initializes on selection, without downloading scripts at runtime. Failed previews retain access to the original file.

dsh-product-preview README · DSH Product Preview Plugin：On RC hosts providing `documentPreviews`, the plugin also registers video, SVGA, and VAP (MP4 / ZIP) in the existing right document Sidebar, sharing the artifact players. Resolution starts only from live file metadata and remains restricted by the media service's `allowedRoots`; no additional directories are exposed. This preview targets host-local files, not identical path strings from remote execution environments. Ordinary video uses native controls and HTTP Range without autoplay. SVGA and VAP retain animation playback with a 64 MiB input cap. Ordinary ZIP remains a file notice, not a VAP animation. File changes, reloads, and tab closure cancel pending reads and release players. Decoder failures retain the host's original-file actions. Older hosts without this extension keep the artifact view without requiring installation of the new preview module.

dsh-product-preview README · DSH Product Preview Plugin：On desktop, a two-finger horizontal swipe across the content area switches between Chat, Products, and Trajectory. The edge cue grows with the gesture and stays hidden when no adjacent tab exists.

dsh-product-preview README · DSH Product Preview Plugin：It reads successful tool results and assistant text, discovers absolute file paths, then assigns each path to the first timeline node that reported it. Extensionless files can be reported as JSON path values, backtick paths, or Markdown links. The UI preserves names and only lists existing regular files under `allowedRoots`, without scanning directories. Non-media content is served as an attachment. The preview size limit does not exclude files from the list.

dsh-product-preview README · DSH Product Preview Plugin：The bundle has no product or Bot dependency. A Desktop host may optionally expose native actions such as Open, Reveal in Finder, and the context menu through `/api/product-preview/actions`.

dsh-product-preview README · DSH Product Preview Plugin：Path discovery supports absolute POSIX paths, Windows drive paths with either slash style, and UNC shares (`\\server\share\image.png`), preserving Unicode and spaces. An explicit absolute directory ending in a slash, quoted in backticks or a Markdown link, supplies the base for relative file references in the immediately following Markdown list. The base stays within that list and is never inferred across messages or JSON fields. Unbased relative paths, relative paths containing `..`, network URLs, and Windows device paths are not local media artifacts. Discovery does not grant access; shared paths must also be under the host's configured `allowedRoots`.

dsh-product-preview README · Installation and compatibility：Artifact-view peers accept DSH Web / Desktop `0.1.2-alpha.3`, `0.2.0-rc.1`, and `0.2.0-rc.2`. Right-sidebar media uses the optional RC document preview API types; preview and native actions still require acceptance on a new host. Requires Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

Use a prebuilt package from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/choco9527/dsh-product-preview/releases) in the target profile:

dsh-product-preview README · Installation and compatibility：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/choco9527/dsh-product-preview/releases/latest/download/dsh-product-preview.tgz
```

For Desktop, replace `web` with the actual profile name. The plugin reuses the host's DSH and React dependencies and ships neither Desktop nor a Bot. Configure allowed directories after installation; the empty default does not expose the whole disk.

dsh-product-preview README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: product-preview
  name: dsh-product-preview
  config:
    allowedRoots:

Supported local formats are PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV, WebM, M4V, and SVGA. The bundled `svga.lite` package lets packed installations preview SVGA files without a network download.

dsh-product-preview README · Desktop AI animation reading：The build also emits `lib/media-reader.js` for Argo's isolated, hidden Electron media reader. It does not mount the preview page, use the user's browser, or start an HTTP/MCP service. It reuses the existing `svga.lite`, `video-animation-player`, `fflate`, and Electron decoders without adding dependencies or FFmpeg. Video frames use native decoding; VAP frames contain composited RGB/alpha; SVGA v2 samples render immutable single-frame sprite selections without relying on hidden-window animation clocks.

dsh-product-preview README · Desktop AI animation reading：The default is three interior samples; callers may request 1–6 frames or explicit timestamps in seconds below the duration. Alpha-preserving PNGs have a maximum 2000px edge. Inputs and expanded SVGA data are limited to 64 MiB; VAP ZIP retains its existing limits. Corrupt files, unsupported codecs, legacy SVGA ZIP, and dynamic VAPX fail explicitly. External SVGA avatar/text replacements are not inferred. Samples are neither continuous playback nor audio transcription, and originals remain unchanged. The host owns timeout, cancellation, sandboxing, local path checks, and durable image attachments for conversation replay.

dsh-product-preview README · Desktop AI animation reading：Use Node.js 22 or newer and pnpm through Corepack:

```sh
corepack pnpm install
corepack pnpm run typecheck
corepack pnpm test
corepack pnpm run package

Development dependencies install from the public npm registry without a sibling Desktop checkout. DSH and React are host peer dependencies. SVGA is a development dependency compiled into the browser bundle; installing a prebuilt package requires no build scripts on the user's machine.

dsh-product-preview README · Desktop AI animation reading：Development dependencies supply the host types used by the plugin. `skipLibCheck` skips validation inside third-party declarations: the DSH alpha declarations reference host-generated RPC types that cannot be fully checked in a standalone plugin. Plugin source remains checked with `strict` enabled.
